name: Korbu Waterfall
full: Korbu Waterfall at the mouth of the Bolshaya Korbu River, eastern shore of Lake Teletskoye, Altai Nature Reserve
near: Yaylyu settlement (the reserve's estate, eastern shore); the starting villages for boats are Artybash and Iogach (≈25–30 km by water)
elev: Lake level 434 m; height of the water drop 12.5–12.8 m
short: The best-known and most accessible waterfall of Lake Teletskoye: a 12-meter stream drops from a slanting rock ledge right at the shore; it can be reached only by water.
desc: Korbu is a waterfall on the Bolshaya Korbu River right where it flows into Lake Teletskoye, on the eastern shore, on the territory of the Altai Biosphere Reserve. The drop is 12.8 m according to the reserve (12–13 m in other sources). The stream falls from an inclined rock ledge, breaks on the stones and spreads in a wide fan. A natural monument since 1978. The waterfall can be visited only from the water: boats and motor ships go from Artybash and Iogach, ≈25 km one way. From the pier a short eco-trail (≈0.2 km, 30–40 minutes for the visit) with wooden decking and a viewing platform has been laid, and nearby are a visitor center, kiosks and a cafe. It is the reserve's most visited route: 47,640 people in 2012 and more than 40 thousand in 2014. The route is usually open from May to September and is included in almost all boat programs (“5 Wonders”, “7 Wonders”, “Golden Ring”). In 2005 the waterfall was temporarily closed because of the influx of tourists and unauthorized construction, and in 2026 the route is closed from the end of August to the end of the season because of the danger of bear encounters.
guide: Korbu is not about scale but about the journey: the sail itself across the lake with mountains on both sides is the main impression. Step off the boat, walk along the decking to the platform and go up to the spray — in the heat it is the best shower in Altai. Don't spend all your time at the water: on the route there is a cafe with cedar coffee and chebureki with grayling. If you want photos without a crowd, take an early boat — by noon almost everyone moors at Korbu. On the way on the “5 Wonders” trip you will also see Kishte, Estyuba and the Stone Monkey.
see: The waterfall itself from the viewing platform and from below at the rocks; the eco-trail with the reserve's flora and rock outcrops; on the way — the waterfalls Kishte, Estyuba, Choodor and Ayu-Kechpes (from the water), Love Island, the “Stone Monkey”, Stone Bay
skip: you expect a grand waterfall — Korbu is only 12 m, and Lonely Planet honestly writes that the waterfall itself is “not memorable”, while the route across the lake is what impresses; or you dislike crowds and loud boat tours
diff: Easy (a short 0.2 km trail; the rocks by the water are slippery)
when: May–September; fullest in late spring and early summer; July–August is the crowd peak
hours: The reserve route is usually open from May to September during the daytime boat services; in 2026 it was closed from 17–20 August (temporarily) and from 31 August to the end of the season
daytime: Morning — the first boats and fewer people; after noon there are many vessels at the pier
how: Only by water. Drive to Artybash or Iogach (≈160 km from Gorno-Altaysk), where you board a boat or motor ship. The sail is ≈25 km one way (reserve), about 2–2.5 h for the whole trip with the visit; Korbu is included in the programs “5 Wonders” (3 h), “7 Wonders” (3.5–4 h) and “Golden Ring” (7–8 h). One-day tours with transfer are sold from Gorno-Altaysk and Manzherok (≈7800–10,800 ₽, 10–12 h).
needcar: Yes — a boat is mandatory (there is no access by land)
self: Yes — drive to Artybash and buy a seat on a boat at the pier or from an operator; the reserve ticket is usually paid on the spot or included in the excursion
roadtype: Paved road to Artybash; beyond that only water
traveltime: Gorno-Altaysk → Artybash 2.5–4 h; boat Artybash → Korbu ≈40–60 min one way (estimated from the programs of 3-hour tours with several stops)
stay: There is no overnight stay at the waterfall itself (reserve). Accommodation is in Artybash and Iogach: from 700–2200 ₽ (economy) to 6000–46,000 ₽ per night (see “Lake Teletskoye”)
net: At the waterfall — no reliable data found; a reliable signal only in Artybash and Iogach
entry: A ticket for the reserve's ecological-educational route costs 250 ₽/person (since 27.02.2025); reviews mention 150 ₽ (2020) and 750 ₽ in cash for several waterfalls on the route; KP gives 100 ₽ (2026) — contradictory. Often included in group tours. Children passed for free in 2012. Tour operators in 2026 list eco fees of ≈750 ₽ for the three waterfalls of the route (Sputnik8).
transfer: A boat 2000–4000 ₽/person as part of a group (2026); an individual boat from 23,000–43,000 ₽
bring: A windbreaker/warm jacket (it is cold on the water, the lower wind), shoes with a non-slip sole, cash (fees and cafe), sun protection
warn: In 2026 the route is closed from 31.08 to the end of the season because of bears (after a tourist died near Artybash on 19.08.2026). Slippery rocks by the jets. In a storm the boats don't go out or turn back. Insist on life jackets — in reviews there were boats with no safety briefing.
food: Cedar coffee and Altai herbal tea at the cafe on the route; the Altyn-Ay cafe at one of the route's waterfalls — chebureki with grayling, local tinctures (per a Tripster review)
reviews: 2GIS: Korbu waterfall — 4.9 (80 ratings). Tours with Korbu: 4.9 (151 reviews) and 4.8 (17) on Sputnik8. Pros: views from the boat, convenient decking, a cafe, toilets; cons: crowds, “the waterfall is small” (Lonely Planet), a transfer on a bad road, loud commentary on the boat, unexpected extra charges (eco fees up to 750 ₽ for three waterfalls)

p.sum: Korbu is a short stop (30–40 min) on a boat trip from Artybash/Iogach; you can't get there by land. The cheapest option is the group “5 Wonders” boat (3500 ₽, 3 h) + the reserve ticket (250 ₽, 2025). Season May–September; in 2026 the route has been closed since 31 August.

p.permits: A border-zone permit is not needed. A ticket for the reserve route (250 ₽, 2025), registration on the route. For your own boats — the reserve's permission to sail to the Korbu eco-trail (since 2025; Artybash, Teletskaya St., 12; Yaylyu, Tsentralnaya St., 14; passport, boat ticket, boat operator's license).
p.access: Suitable for children and older people (a short trail, decking), but the route is not officially adapted for people with limited mobility. Dogs — not found.
